caption.text:
Some people confuse anxiety with love because chaos is all they’ve ever known.

But real love does not leave you guessing. It does not make you feel like you have to earn reassurance, chase consistency, or abandon yourself just to keep someone close. Real love feels safe. Steady. Honest. It lets your nervous system rest.

Attachment says: “I need you so I can feel okay.”
Love says: “I choose you, and I still choose myself too.”

One keeps you in survival mode.
The other feels like peace.

Maybe healing is learning that butterflies are not always a sign of destiny. Sometimes they are a sign that your heart has been living in uncertainty for too long.

You deserve a love that grounds you, not one that unravels you. 🖤

Book: Detached by Sabrina Bendory 📖 Find the link in our bio.

#love #attachment #lovelessons
